target_auxiliary.resolution_note: B = 199: smallest attainable p 0.005 vs first Holm threshold 0.00625

definition.d_ri(h): ED_U(shared direct, shared sequential)_ri - ED_U(independent direct, independent sequential)_ri; negative = shared smaller gap
definition.Theta_h: mean over examples of the mean over the four fit-pairs of d_ri(h); conditional on these fits; not a population effect
definition.intervals: per replicate: normal 95% CI over examples (pointwise); overall: normal CI over the per-example replicate means; cluster bootstrap resampling examples and carrying every pair, arm and solver value of an example (2000 resamples)
definition.not_pooled: 4 x 200 values are not 800 independent observations; no clipping of negative ED_U

analysis.solver_note: paired per-example differences on shared initial noise; agreement does not prove ODE-limit convergence; results describe the implemented sampler
